events.title: Metroidvania Maker Demo Launches September 18!
events.summary: It's finally happening!The free demo for Metroidvania Maker launches on Steam on September 18.The demo will let you jump into a playable Metroidvania world, try out the editor, build and share your own worlds, and play solo or in local co-op.I've been working toward getting this demo out for quite a while now, so I'm really excited to finally let people play it.See you on September 18!
